Switzerland Seasonal Travel Calendar

Month-by-month guide to Switzerland's weather, cherry blossoms, autumn leaves, festivals and busy holiday periods.

Choose a month for a snapshot of weather, nature, festivals and crowds. Dates for blossoms and foliage vary each year; festival dates can change — check official event sites and the JNTO website before you go.

January

WeatherCrisp winter air (2–10°C); alpine snow
CrowdsLow in cities; busy in ski resorts

Nature & scenery

Snow-dusted mountains and quiet museum halls in Zurich and Lucerne.

Festivals & events

  • New Year celebrations
  • Winter illuminations

Where shines this month

Zurich museums & winter mountains

Packing

Warm coat, scarf, gloves, and waterproof boots.

February

WeatherCool winter days (3–12°C)
CrowdsLow to moderate

Nature & scenery

Early blossoms in southern regions and winter carnivals across Switzerland.

Festivals & events

  • Winter festivals & carnival parades
  • Seasonal culinary markets

Where shines this month

Zurich, Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region & alpine resorts

Packing

Layered winter jacket and thermal base layers.

March

WeatherEarly spring transition (7–16°C)
CrowdsModerate

Nature & scenery

Spring gardens waking up across Zurich and Lucerne.

Festivals & events

  • Spring equinox celebrations
  • Art & design fairs

Where shines this month

Zurich & Lucerne

Packing

Trench coat or light down jacket and umbrella.

April

WeatherMild spring weather (10–19°C)
CrowdsModerate to high

Nature & scenery

Blooming parks, outdoor café terraces, and crisp sightseeing weather across Switzerland.

Festivals & events

  • Spring cultural festivals
  • Open-air food markets

Where shines this month

Zurich, Lucerne & Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region

Packing

Light layers, comfortable walking shoes, and sunglasses.

May

WeatherWarm, sunny late spring (14–23°C)
CrowdsModerate to high

Nature & scenery

Lush green valleys, coastal trails, and long daylight hours across Switzerland.

Festivals & events

  • May Day & spring holidays
  • Outdoor music & wine festivals

Where shines this month

All regions of Switzerland

Packing

Breathable shirts, light sweater for evenings, sunscreen.

June

WeatherEarly summer warmth (18–27°C)
CrowdsHigh

Nature & scenery

Longest days of the year — ideal for scenic rail routes, islands, and mountain passes.

Festivals & events

  • Midsummer concerts
  • Local patron saints' festivals

Where shines this month

Coastlines, lakes & mountain regions

Packing

Light summer clothing, sun hat, and light rain shell.

July

WeatherPeak summer sunshine (22–31°C)
CrowdsHigh (summer holidays)

Nature & scenery

Vibrant coastal towns, high mountain hiking trails, and open-air evening plazas.

Festivals & events

  • Summer music & theater festivals
  • Waterfront fireworks

Where shines this month

High mountains & coastal breezes

Packing

Linen/cotton clothes, refillable water bottle, UV protection.

August

WeatherWarm summer days (22–32°C)
CrowdsHigh

Nature & scenery

Festival season across towns and villages, plus alpine and coastal escapes.

Festivals & events

  • Mid-August national holiday festivities
  • Village harvest & night markets

Where shines this month

Mountain escapes & northern regions

Packing

Light breathable clothing and sun protection.

September

WeatherGolden early autumn (17–25°C)
CrowdsModerate to high

Nature & scenery

Warm seas, grape and food harvests, and relaxed post-summer city streets.

Festivals & events

  • Wine & harvest festivals
  • Heritage Open Days

Where shines this month

Zurich, Lucerne, Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region & wine regions

Packing

Light daytime wear plus a cardigan or jacket for evenings.

October

WeatherCrisp autumn foliage (12–20°C)
CrowdsModerate

Nature & scenery

Autumn colors across parks, forests, and historic towns.

Festivals & events

  • Autumn food & truffle/chestnut fairs
  • Cultural nights

Where shines this month

Lucerne, Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region & countryside

Packing

Medium jacket, scarf, and broken-in walking shoes.

November

WeatherCool late autumn (7–15°C)
CrowdsLow

Nature & scenery

Quiet museums, cozy bistros, and misty historic streets with zero queues.

Festivals & events

  • New oil & wine tastings
  • Late-November winter light-ups

Where shines this month

Zurich & Lucerne cultural sights

Packing

Warm coat, sweater, and compact umbrella.

December

WeatherFestive winter (3–11°C)
CrowdsModerate (high around holidays)

Nature & scenery

Holiday markets, twinkling town squares, and early-season snow in the mountains.

Festivals & events

  • Christmas & winter markets
  • New Year's Eve concerts

Where shines this month

Zurich, Lucerne & festive market towns

Packing

Winter coat, warm hat, gloves, and layered knitwear.

Switzerland's busiest holiday periods

  • New Year (around 29 Dec – 3 Jan): many businesses close; transport busy.
  • Golden Week (about 29 Apr – 5 May): one of the busiest domestic travel periods.
  • Obon (around mid-August): heavy travel as people return home.
  • Silver Week (some years, mid-late September).
